Nina Park: Heads-up: small-but-important follow-up to the SDK/Docs rollout — we9re publishing SDK v4.0.1 tomorrow with a docs localization push (DE/FR/JP) and a short deprecation for the legacy /eval endpoint. Please scan the migration note: https://intranet.redwood.local/docs/guides/sdk-4-patch
Sam Ortiz: Quick Q: what exactly is deprecated on /eval? Is it the endpoint or query params?
Nina Park: The legacy /eval endpoint that returned raw HTML snippets is deprecated. New /evaluations returns structured JSON with a status field and metrics. Servers will emit warning headers for 60 days.
Maya: Any breaking change for SDKs? I maintain the Ruby client.
Nina Park: Ruby + Go will get a minor shim update to parse the new evaluation JSON. We ship adapters in 4.0.1 that keep the old method signature but log a deprecation notice. No immediate break, but remove reliance within 2 months.
Docs-bot: New pages: /docs/guides/eval-api-v2, /docs/locales/de/sdk-guide, /docs/locales/fr/sdk-guide, /docs/locales/ja/sdk-guide. Search reindex: job 20260620-78.
Eng-APIs-bot: Rollout timeline: patch rollout 2026-06-15 02:00 PT (canary), warning headers for legacy /eval start 2026-06-16, legacy endpoint disabled 2026-08-16. Dedicated/Private customers have opt-out toggle until 2026-10-16.
Sam Ortiz: Can CS get a list of customers still calling /eval? We need to contact any >500 calls/week folks before 2026-07-01.
CS-bot: Yes 50> weekly export scheduled: Console -> Admin -> API Usage -> Evaluation Endpoint. CSV delivered every Monday.
Nina Park: Migration snippet (JS):
```
// old
await fetch('/eval', { method: 'POST', body: promptHtml });

// new
await fetch('/evaluations', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: promptText }) });
```
Maya: For localization: are the localized pages full translations or machine-assisted? I9ll coordinate a spot-check.
Docs-bot: Locales are human-reviewed + machine-drafts for low-traffic pages. QA checklist posted in /docs/internal/i18n-checklist.
Nina Park: Action items: docs team confirm translated landing pages, eng-apis validate compatibility adapters, cs run initial export and flag high-usage customers, eng-runtime monitor deprecation header rates. Report blockers in #release-war-room.
Nina Park: Thanks all 44b
